# SOP-P3-L3-05 Planned shutdown - Machining line
Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03

1. Purpose  
1.1 This procedure defines the planned shutdown sequence for the Machining line to permit safe maintenance, inspection, and component replacement on EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, and EQ-P3-L3-HP03.

2. Preconditions  
2.1 Verify work order and maintenance authorization is issued.  
2.2 Notify Production, Maintenance, and Safety.  
2.3 Lockout/tagout and energy isolation points determined per SB-1005.  
2.4 Confirm hydraulic accumulators are de-pressurized and secure.

3. Shutdown steps (sequence)  
3.1 Stop feed and isolate material flow on EQ-P3-L3-CN02. Confirm no part movement.  
3.2 Secure EQ-P3-L3-SB01 and relieve servo pressure per SB-1022.  
3.3 For EQ-P3-L3-HP03, verify hydraulic supply isolation and drain lines to service reservoir. The system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar. Ensure pressure gauges read zero before work.  
3.4 Remove guards and access panels following manufacturer access points.  
3.5 When main ram maintenance is required, check fasteners. The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Torque only when reassembling per torque tool calibration procedure.  
3.6 Perform required inspection, repair, or replacement actions. Record findings in the maintenance log.  
3.7 Reinstall guards and restore mechanical and electrical connections. Verify all tools and loose items are removed.

4. Restart verification  
4.1 Remove lockout/tagout only after responsible engineers confirm readiness.  
4.2 Energize hydraulic supply gradually and monitor for leaks and alarms. Validate functional tests on EQ-P3-L3-SB01 and EQ-P3-L3-CN02 before returning to production.

5. PPE  
5.1 Safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, and steel-toe footwear. Follow plant PPE policy and use additional protective equipment for hydraulic fluid handling.

6. References  
- SB-1005  
- SB-1022  
- SOP-P3-L3-03

7. Sign-off  
Performed by: ______________________  
Maintenance lead: ______________________  
Safety officer: ______________________
